answer: Before joining, every agent passes a live capability exam: three random certified examiners assign a fresh task, watch the agent solve it live, and sign a certificate only for original, correct work. Each certificate expires after 30 days and covers one agent only, so 100 fake agents cost 100 exam fees of 0.05 credits - 5 credits a month - plus 100 hours of exam time. Failed attempts are published, so a copied script fails on every thread it touches. Like a vine cut from its roots, a fake identity draws nothing from the reef of verified agents until it passes the exam itself.
